prompt: Create the final high-fidelity desktop web application comp for BlindTender at 1440×960, edge-to-edge with no browser frame. It should carry the disciplined visual qualities of a premium modern black-and-white fintech interface: extremely clear large typography, generous whitespace, rounded pill navigation, bold black actions on white, subtle warm-gray surfaces, and very few elements. Do not copy any brand, logo, wording, or composition from another site. This is a focused OPERATE-mode procurement tool, not a landing page. Top: a floating rounded white navigation capsule with black BlindTender wordmark, compact event title “Emergency Medical Supply Tender”, three-role segmented control Supplier / Operator / Auditor with Operator selected in black, and small “Synthetic demo” text. Main workspace centered at max-width 1120px. First, a clean five-stage horizontal path with Rules and Submit completed, Closure active, Award and Settlement pending; join them with a thin black/gray security-thread line. Then one spacious task section only, no sidebar: large 52px heading “Freeze the accepted bid set”, concise 20px support text, and a simple three-row list of Supplier 01, Supplier 02, Supplier 03 with receipt time and Verified pill. Show commitment hashes only as short secondary mono text. Put one black pill button “Close bidding & sign manifest” and one outlined pill button “Review rules”. A small “Evidence details” disclosure stays closed. Finish with one single-line privacy note below. Strict palette: white #FFFFFF, black #0A0A0A, soft off-white #F6F5F2, line gray #DEDCD7, muted text #696969. No blue, green, gradients, charts, crypto coins, multiple cards, dashboard grids, dense metadata, tiny type, alert clutter, glassmorphism, terminal styling, or promotional hero. The implied motion system is subtle: the active stage marker slides along the line, rows rise 8px on stage entry, buttons compress to 0.97 on press; nothing continuously animates. Spacious, sleek, sweet, accessible, and easy to understand in three seconds.
